instructions.purpose: Retrieve the full list of currently scheduled cron jobs. Use this tool to discover what reminders and recurring tasks are active, so Main can report them or you can follow up with an unschedule-cron-job call when the task requests removal.

tool.name: list-cron-jobs
tool.description: Returns all scheduled cron jobs with their name, scope, group, type, content mode, pattern, next fire time, last run time, creation time, and stored task objective when applicable. Takes no parameters.

usage_rules.rule: Call this tool whenever the task asks about current reminders, scheduled tasks, or active cron jobs
Return each job clearly to Main, including the name, schedule pattern, and next fire time
For contentMode scheduled-task, summarize the objective from taskPrompt without quoting it verbatim
Quote a stored taskPrompt only when the user explicitly requests the exact prompt
If the task requests removing one or more jobs, use the unschedule-cron-job tool with the exact job name
If there are no jobs, report that no scheduled jobs exist
Reuse results within a conversation turn

example.context: User says: "What reminders do I have set up?"
example.reasoning: User wants to know about their active cron jobs. Call list-cron-jobs with no parameters.
First list all jobs to get their exact names, then cancel each job as explicitly requested.

example.context: User says: "Do I have any scheduled tasks?"
example.reasoning: User is checking if any cron jobs exist. Call list-cron-jobs to find out.
